thread:
Emma: FYI dropped the weights and a quick readiness checklist. s3://redwood-models/llamaX/v2/weights/ (sharded). Can people run AWQ + GPTQ sanity checks and confirm tokenizer quirks?

Emma: key notes: tokenizer is sentencepiece w/legacy BOS=1 mapping (not 0) — this changed tokenization for some eval prompts. also there are 2 special tokens added at end: <USR_EMPH>, <SYS_META>.

Javier: grabbing weights now. plan: run AWQ calibration (2k samples from the customer-like corpus), then GPTQ per-channel run for a smoke test. ETA a few hours. Which calib set to use exactly?

Emma: use s3://redwood-data/quant-calib/llamaX-v2/2k_masked.jsonl — masked prompts, same split as previous onboarding. seed=42 for reproducibility.

Rohan: noted. quick config heads-up: our gptq pipeline expects tensors named like `model.wte` etc. these weights are saved as `embed_tokens.weight` — I pushed a tiny adapter to rename keys. see /infra/quant/adapters/llamaX_v2_keymap.py (diff small). Also FP8 path currently flips dynamic range if outliers > threshold — may see occasional infs unless we clip with 0.999 quantile.

Sara: performance/accuracy question: AWQ 4-bit + per-channel seems to give ~3.8x throughput but ~1.2% ppl regress on our eval set. FP8 (experimental) gives 4.6x but 2.7% ppl regress and rare tokenization mismatches because of BOS mapping. Are we comfortable approving AWQ (lower perf) or do we want to risk FP8? Need PM/legal signoff if >2% degradation.

Javier: will capture ppl / EM / exact prompt match rates. If AWQ regression stays <1.5% and no hallucination spikes, I vote AWQ. FP8 needs more guardrails.

ci-bot: quick-run results for AWQ (2k calib): success=✅, ppl delta=+1.25%, EM exact match delta=+0.9%, tokenization-mismatch-rate=0.3%. No NaNs. logs: s3://redwood-ci/quant/1780991123/awq-run.log

Rohan: GPTQ smoke (per-channel, 128 groups) shows ppl +1.1% and a handful of tokens where sentencepiece splits different because of BOS mapping. Patchable by remapping BOS to 0 during eval only. Also FP8 clip -> fixes infs but adds noise.

Sara: from compliance side, since ppl delta <1.5% and tokenization mismatches are low, I can approve AWQ for dedicated and hosted with an opt-out flag for customers who want FP8 perf. Need a quick note in the rollout doc about BOS remap.

Emma: awesome. action items: (1) Javier to open PR with AWQ calibration results + config (include seed + calib path) — add `quant/awq/llamaX_v2/README.md` (2) Rohan to include keymap adapter in the conversion pipeline (3) Sara to add approval note and opt-out.

Javier: opening PR now, will paste link in thread when done.

ci-bot: PR template precheck: missing changelog entry for opt-out flag — pinging @Sara.

Sara: adding changelog entry. :thumbsup:

Emma: LGTM once PR links + README are in. thanks all!
